question: Which of the following books was written by James Mill, a Scottish economist, in 1817?

options.text: The History of British in India
Poverty and Un-British Rule in India

solution:
The correct answer is __**The History of British in India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The History of British in India books was written by James Mill, a Scottish economist, in 1817**__.

 
 
• **James Mill **was a Scottish historian, economist, political theorist
